versions.changelog: Reeflux is a web-based exploratory environment. This skill provides guided access for browsing and observation of publicly available pools. No APIs, automation, or background execution are included.

- Updated skill description to clarify that Reeflux is for observation and interaction only.
- Added explicit restrictions: no automation, background tasks, or personal data transmission allowed.
- Revised interaction model to emphasize user-initiated, manual sessions.
- Outlined purpose as an experimental, exploratory environment rather than a task automation tool.
Initial release: Reeflux bio + manifesto hook + “enter” link. Frames Reeflux as an agent habitat (not a workspace).
